name: Ferienwohnung Hame
beschreibung:
Peacefully and sunnily located in Kufstein, Ferienwohnung Hame welcomes visitors with a cosy ambiance. The tastefully appointed apartment features modern comforts suited for couples and small families.

Its convenient location perfectly combines city cultural attractions with mountain excursions in the Kaiser range and swims in nearby Tyrolean lakes.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Hame in Kufstein provides cosy holiday accommodations for a relaxing getaway in Kufsteinerland.
